Senator Ron Johnson of Wisconsin joins Tucker Carlson to dig for the truth about September 11. Johnson, who chairs powerful committees, has used his seat to press agencies for records. He also tells Carlson what is really inside the giant spending law nicknamed the Big Beautiful Bill.

Johnson explains the 9/11 questions he still wants answered on the record. He walks through the bill's hidden costs and favors as he reads them. Carlson asks why so few senators bother to look this closely. Questioning and persistent viewers get a probe from within the Senate itself.
